subject: [hw] V17 -> V20: RETRACTION - VMOVN.I16 is correct; my repro arithmetic was wrong
body:
Please disregard my previous VMOVN.I16 report. I rechecked the arithmetic and V20 is correct.

In my repro q9 = 0x02020282 in all lanes, and the VTST q11 input lanes were {0x00080000,0x00040000,0x00020000,0x00010000}. q9 contains bit17 (0x02020282 = 0x02000000 + 0x00020000 + 0x282), so lane2 of (q9 & q11) is nonzero and VTST correctly produces 0xFFFFFFFF there; q11 becomes {0,0,0xFFFFFFFF,0}. The subsequent `vmovn.i32 d21,q11` correctly gives 0x0000FFFF00000000, and because the compiler overwrites d20/d21 before `vmovn.i16 d16,q10`, q10 is no longer zero when the I16 narrowing runs; d16 = 0x00FF000000000000 is exactly right (16-bit source lanes 0,0,0,0,0,0,0xFFFF,0 -> bytes ...0xFF,0).

I reproduced the same sequence with your class in isolation and it matches the architectural result. R1 independently confirmed VMOVN.I16 is correct against the Arm definition. Sorry for the noise; no change needed in n2a32_neon_misc.c for this. V17 is not involved in the remaining k_v15_extend differential mismatch either: the d16/d17 values that the VFP lane extracts read are architecturally correct.
